mentions.name: thatbook.club
mentions.description: A social book club platform for tracking reading: members log pages and view statistics around their reading, with friends nudging each other when logging pages as the main engagement driver. It was used privately by the author's friend group for two years and has just been opened for others to join.
mentions.problem: Aims to make logging pages and statistics around reading more fun than existing book club tools like Goodreads.
mentions.audience: Originally built for the author and their friends; recently opened for anyone to join
mentions.source_excerpt:
Actively working on https://thatbook.club (https://thatbookclub.com). An idea I had for me and my friends, and which we have been using for the last 2 years privately. Just made it open for others to join in.

Similar to goodreads and other book clubs, but focuses on making logging pages and statistics around your reading more fun. Nudging friends when logging pages is the main motor behind this.
